# Without run_as_cel: true the template is not for the httpjson input
# running as CEL, so cel.program is not a program that we know about.
celfmt -agent -i src.cel
! stderr .
cmp stdout src.cel

celfmt -agent -i nested.cel
! stderr .
cmp stdout nested.cel

-- src.cel --
interval: {{interval}}
cel.program: |-
  state.with({"events":[],"want_more":false})
-- nested.cel --
interval: {{interval}}
cel:
  program: |-
    state.with({"events":[],"want_more":false})
